SiteReview.title: SiteReview
SiteReview.description: Public star rating and clinical feedback review submitted by users for the PIOBARI RSUD Palembang BARI website.

authorName.description: Full name or display name of the reviewer (non-anonymous).

institution.description: Hospital unit, workplace, or city of the reviewer.

aspect.description: Application module or feature being evaluated.

tags.description: Optional list of up to 5 quick appreciation tags.

comment.description: Review comment text provided by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created (immutable).

helpfulCount.description: Number of helpful upvotes received by this review.

verified.description: Indicates the review passed server validation.

isPublic.description: Indicates the review is publicly visible on the PIOBARI review wall.

adminReplyText.description: Optional official reply from the RSUD Palembang BARI clinical pharmacy team.

adminRepliedBy.description: Name of the admin team responding to the review.

adminRepliedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin reply was saved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/site_reviews/{reviewId}.description: Stores real-time, persistent user star ratings and comments for the PIOBARI website.

/admins/{userId}.description: Stores authorized administrator UIDs for role-based moderation.
